data.content_ref: inline:190d009cd72e depends on SRC_010: the $855 figure is the canonical synthesis that integrates the base rate on regular hours with the 1.5× rate on overtime hours, avoiding the reductive errors of $846 (flat base), $909 (premium-on-base), and $1269 (premium-all). It refutes all three if the overtime law defines a piecewise rate function (40×$18 + 7×$27) rather than a global multiplier or additive premium. REFUTED IF the applicable wage law defines overtime as a 0.5× supplement on top of the base rate for all hours.
